تبتكرون (form VIII)
# تَبْتَكِرُونَ (tabtakirūna) /tab.ta.ki.ruː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِبْتَكَرَ (ibtakara)
# تُبْتَكَرُونَ (tubtakarūna) /tub.ta.ka.ruː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِبْتَكَرَ (ibtakara)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
